data.name: Prodyut
data.long_meaning: One who creates or produces, be it an idea, a product, or a child.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are creators of their own destiny and are blessed with the ability to produce positive change.

in_sanskrit.name: प्रसदुद्युत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who sends forth offerings or blessings

in_hindi.name: प्रोद्युत
in_hindi.meaning: प्रसाद (prasada) + उद्युत (udyut) = प्रसादित (prasadita) + उद्यत (udyat) = प्रसादित (offered) + उद्यत (active/ready)
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is active and ready after being offered

in_tamil.name: ப்ரோட்யூட்
in_tamil.meaning: ப்ராஸதம் (prasadam) + உட்யுத் (udyutam) = உட்யத்தில் (udyatil) அதுவும் ப்ராஸதம் (prasadam) அல்லவல் விழுத்துக்கள் (offered items) அல்லவல் உட்யத்தில் (in the active/ready state)

in_marathi.name: Prodyut
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prodyut हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who creates or produces, be it an idea, a product, or a child.

in_bengali.name: Prodyut
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Creator, Producer
in_bengali.long_meaning: Prodyut একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who creates or produces, be it an idea, a product, or a child.

It is a reminder that each one of us possesses the power to bring new ideas, experiences, and even new life into the world. Additionally, the name Prodyut can serve as a reminder to remain truly present in each moment, as the act of creating and producing often requires a deep sense of focus and mindfulness. Ultimately, the name Prodyut invites us to tap into the innate creative force that lies within us and to use it to make a positive impact on the world around us.
